text.KJV NEH 7:42: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

text.KJV NEH 7:44: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.

A.name: Jeshua
A.line: Levite whose sons (descendants) returned to Judah after captivity (EZR 2:40)
A.notes: of the sons of Hodaviah.  A peer/brother of Kadmiel? (EZR 2:40). Father of Jozabad (EZR 8:33)
family: descendant-of hodaviah-5 (Hodaviah, his sons (descendants) returned to Judah after captivity (EZ)

B.name: Jeshua
B.line: explained the law to the people (NEH 8:7), stood on the Levites platform (NEH 9:4), and exhorted Israel to bless the Lord (NEH 9:5)
B.notes: "of" Kadmiel (NEH 7:43), son of Kadmiel (NEH 12:24). Father of Joiakim (NEH 12:10)
family: son-of kadmiel-2 (Kadmiel, stood on the Levites platform (NEH 9:4) and exhorted Israel )
son-of kadmiel (Kadmiel, his sons (descendants) returned to Judah after captivity (EZ)
descendant-of levi (Levi, third-born son of Jacob (GEN 29:34), son of Leah)

why: The Hebrew lists בְנֵי־יֵשׁוּעַ, “the descendants of Jeshua,” under “the Levites,” alongside Kadmiel and Hodevah, matching A’s returning Levite family. It does not identify Jeshua as Kadmiel’s son or connect him with B’s later teaching activities.
